candidate_grammar.boundary: Every finite complete source-ordered product-channel word with held reaction, condition, product and row identities, exact positive support or structural EmptyOne, at least two competing channels and one positive complete support.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of support, whole, relation, identity, absence, record, provenance and prediction forms.

excluded_inputs: no numerical zero; absent reported support is structural EmptyOne and external zero glyphs remain provenance only
no negative, irrational, imaginary, logarithmic, floating, signed or continuum SFT proof value
no imported probability normalization, stochastic premise, branching equation or fitted branching ratio
no renormalization, averaging, selected favorable channel, omitted weak/null/unresolved product or target correction
no branch value, condition, uncertainty, spectrum, analysis result or target hash before all eight identities seal
intended_certificate: Complete 256-form census, one survivor, independent exact-partition reconstruction, depth-independent channel successor, complete eight-product experimental vector, nineteen supplementary files, two PDFs and separate calculated/analysis disclosures.
statement: For one complete source-ordered set of registered product channels, exact retained support forces the complete support as its exact sum and every branch share as channel support over that complete support, with every weak and absent channel retained.
title: Exact complete-support competing-channel branching relation
